-- Good, the verification checks out:
-- Station 3182: 2784 group trips out of 8674 total trips = 0.3209...
-- 
-- The query looks correct. Let me now finalize and submit.
-- The result shows the top 10 stations by proportion of group rides.
-- 
-- Let me also check if there are any stations with 0 total trips that might appear
-- (they shouldn't since we're ordering by proportion DESC and taking top 10)

-- Final query - let me make sure it's clean and correct
WITH same_station_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        end_station_id,
        starttime,
        CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime) / 2) * 2 AS INT64) as two_min_bucket,
        EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) as hr,
        EXTRACT(DATE FROM starttime) as trip_date
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
window_counts AS (
    SELECT start_station_id, trip_date, hr, two_min_bucket, COUNT(*) as window_count
    FROM same_station_trips
    GROUP BY start_station_id, trip_date, hr, two_min_bucket
),
group_trip_flags AS (
    SELECT s.start_station_id, s.end_station_id,
           CASE WHEN wc.window_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_group_trip
    FROM same_station_trips s
    JOIN window_counts wc 
        ON s.start_station_id = wc.start_station_id
        AND s.trip_date = wc.trip_date
        AND s.hr = wc.hr
        AND s.two_min_bucket = wc.two_min_bucket
),
group_trip_counts AS (
    SELECT end_station_id, SUM(is_group_trip) as group_trips
    FROM group_trip_flags
    GROUP BY end_station_id
),
total_trips AS (
    SELECT end_station_id, COUNT(*) as total_trips
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
    SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
    FROM (
        SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name, COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
        GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
    )
)
SELECT 
    t.end_station_id,
    sn.end_station_name as station_name,
    COALESCE(g.group_trips, 0) as group_trips,
    t.total_trips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(g.group_trips, 0), t.total_trips) as proportion
FROM total_trips t
LEFT JOIN group_trip_counts g ON t.end_station_id = g.end_station_id
LEFT JOIN station_names sn ON t.end_station_id = sn.end_station_id AND sn.rn = 1
WHERE t.total_trips > 0
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10
